title: Supertankers Correct from the Extremes, but the Floor Is Firm
section_path: Supertankers Correct from the Extremes, but the Floor Is Firm
section_path_text: Supertankers Correct from the Extremes, but the Floor Is Firm
summary:
Main
By Panagiota Kinti
The VLCC market spent the past week retreating from record highs, but it has not softened by much. Lloyd's List describes crude tankers as in correction after the Hormuz-driven "super spike", with spot rates still at levels unheard of before the crisis and no floor yet found. Clarksons reported VLCC spot earnings down almost 25% on the week to $541,000/day for eco-scrubber units.
